name: localtunnel-monorepo
description: LocalTunnel — expose home services to the public internet through your own VPS, even behind CGNAT.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @localtunnel/protocol && npm run build -w @localtunnel/gateway && npm run build -w @localtunnel/agent
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/protocol/test/*.test.js packages/gateway/test/*.test.js
